# GOATs — the greatest athletes of all time in every sport

> GOATs names the greatest athlete of all time (GOAT) in 322 sports and esports, with legends, stars, other greats and prospects for each, a short explanation of why, the sources used and a fact-check level. The site is bilingual (Brazilian Portuguese first, English at /en/). Last updated 2026-11-14.

How to read the lists:
- Each sport has one or more GOATs, then four tiers: Legends, Stars, Other greats and Prospects (2751 athlete entries in total). Some sports have no consensus GOAT and say so.
- Athletes are judged by how much they dominated their own era, not by comparing eras directly.
- Fact-check level: high (high-impact sources, cited and verified), medium (lower-impact sources, cited and verified), low (quick research across a few sources, not cited).
- Flags show the country the athlete represented; Soviet athletes use the successor country's flag.
- Sports that involve animal exploitation (horse racing, equestrian, rodeo, polo and similar) are deliberately excluded.
- Project created by Julio Cesar Prava (https://linkedin.com/in/juliocesarprava), a special project of BiblioVerse (https://biblioverse.org).

## Pages
- [Home, English](https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/): search and filter every sport, athlete and country; each sport opens with the GOAT and the reasoning
- [Home, Portuguese](https://goat.biblioverse.org/): the same content in Brazilian Portuguese
- [Sources, English](https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/sources.html): every reference used, grouped by sport, with its fact-check level
- [Fontes, Portuguese](https://goat.biblioverse.org/fontes.html): the same list in Portuguese
- [Privacy policy](https://goat.biblioverse.org/en/privacy.html): no sign-up, no tracking cookies, no ads

## Data
- [Full list in English](https://goat.biblioverse.org/llms-full.txt): every sport with all tiers, the explanation and the sources
- [Lista completa em português](https://goat.biblioverse.org/llms-full-pt.txt): the same in Portuguese
- [Dataset in JSON](https://goat.biblioverse.org/data/goats.json): all sports in both languages, with country codes and sources

## GOAT of each sport

Format: sport — GOAT(s). Links open that sport on the site.
